entities.name: Aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase
observations: 370-aa query has 100% coverage and 73.0% identity to reviewed Buchnera aphidicola reference Q8K9B5; enzyme assignment is strong homology support.
Reference enzyme is NADPH-dependent and catalyzes reductive dephosphorylation of L-aspartyl-4-phosphate.

entities.name: ASADH reaction RHEA:24284
observations: Reversible reaction: 4-phospho-L-aspartate + NADPH + H+ = L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde + phosphate + NADP+.
Reference EC classification: EC 1.2.1.11; reaction direction can be written either way, with biosynthetic function proceeding toward aspartate semialdehyde.
